title: Single-page Renev-style agency Home landing (front page only)

requirements.summary: Create a single, section-based Renev-inspired agency Home page experience (no additional routes/pages).
acceptanceCriteria: The app renders a single Home/front page only and does not expose separate About/Services/Portfolio/Blog/Contact pages/routes.
The Home page includes multiple clearly separated, modern marketing sections (at minimum: Hero + 4 additional sections + Footer).
Content is written in English and reads like a modern creative digital agency landing page.

file_operations.description: Implement the single-page Home composition only (no router): render Header + all required sections (Hero, About snapshot, Services, Featured Work, Testimonials, Stats, CTA, Footer) in one scrollable page.
Create the Home page container that composes section components in order and assigns stable section ids for anchor navigation.

Create the on-page header/navigation shell used by the Home page, designed for a modern agency aesthetic. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Button) where appropriate to match existing UI composition patterns. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create Hero section content/layout (headline, subcopy, primary/secondary CTA, hero visual) in a Renev-inspired style; ensure it is part of the single Home page only.
Create a concise agency About snapshot section (positioning, differentiators) as a scroll section on the Home page.

Create Services overview section (cards/grid) as a scroll section on the Home page. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card) where appropriate. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create Featured work/portfolio highlights section (thumbnails + brief case copy) as a scroll section on the Home page.
Create Testimonials section with avatar, quote, role/company; keep it as an in-page section (no route).
Create Metrics/Stats section with numeric highlights, displayed as a modern marketing band section.
Create CTA section (conversion-focused copy + button) as a scroll section on the Home page; keep it purely presentational (no backend submission).
Create Footer section with brand, quick in-page links, and contact-like info (static only; no separate pages/routes).

requirements.summary: Add a sticky on-page header with anchor-link navigation, smooth scrolling, and active section indication (scrollspy).
acceptanceCriteria: Header navigation links scroll to the corresponding sections on the same page.
Smooth scrolling is enabled for in-page section navigation.
The currently active section is visually indicated in the navigation as the user scrolls.

file_operations.description: Implement a scrollspy hook (IntersectionObserver-based) that tracks which Home section is currently active and exposes the active section id for the header.

Wire anchor links (href=#section-id) to Home sections and use the scrollspy hook to visually indicate the active section; ensure keyboard focus/visibility remains accessible. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Button) for nav actions if appropriate. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Enable smooth scrolling for in-page anchor navigation (e.g., via global html scroll behavior) and add any minimal global styles needed for the sticky header offset behavior.

requirements.summary: Define and apply a consistent modern agency visual theme (palette, typography, spacing, components) across all Home sections.
acceptanceCriteria: A single consistent design system is evident across all Home sections (typography scale, spacing rhythm, button styles, card styles).
The page looks polished on both mobile and desktop breakpoints.
No blue+purple default theme is used unless it emerges incidentally from the chosen palette; prefer a distinct, modern agency palette.

file_operations.description: Define a cohesive theme via CSS variables used by Tailwind (background/foreground/primary/accent/etc.), set global typography defaults, and establish consistent spacing/section styling; choose a distinct modern agency palette (avoid default blue+purple look).

Extend Tailwind theme tokens as needed for the landing page (e.g., additional neutral/brand shades, shadows, spacing/typography tweaks) while keeping existing Tailwind + shadcn/ui composition patterns.
Apply consistent layout primitives (max widths, padding, section separators/bands) and responsive breakpoints so the design remains polished on mobile and desktop.

requirements.summary: Add modern interactions: hover/press states and subtle scroll-reveal animations for major sections without harming accessibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Buttons/links/cards have clear hover and active/pressed states.
Major sections reveal with subtle animation on scroll (without impacting readability or performance).
Animations do not block navigation and do not trap focus (keyboard navigation remains usable).

file_operations.description: Create a lightweight in-view hook (IntersectionObserver-based) to support scroll-reveal animations for major sections.
Create a ScrollReveal wrapper that applies subtle entrance transitions when content enters the viewport; respect reduced-motion preferences and avoid focus traps.
Wrap major Home sections with ScrollReveal to animate on scroll while keeping navigation and readability intact.
Add consistent interaction states (hover/active/focus-visible) for links/buttons/cards and ensure reduced-motion handling is supported globally.

requirements.summary: Render key Home sections from centralized reusable content data structures (services, featured projects, testimonials, stats).
acceptanceCriteria: At least services, featured projects, and testimonials (or comparable sets) are rendered from centralized arrays/objects.
Updating an item in the data structure updates the rendered UI without editing multiple locations.

file_operations.description: Create centralized Home content data (arrays/objects) for services, featured projects, testimonials, and stats, including copy and local image references.

Render the services UI from the centralized homeContent data structures to avoid duplicated hardcoding. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card) where appropriate. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Render featured projects from the centralized homeContent data structures; ensure each project card uses the locally generated thumbnail references.
Render testimonials from the centralized homeContent data structures; ensure each testimonial uses a locally generated avatar reference.
Render stats/metrics from the centralized homeContent data structures for consistency and easy updates.

requirements.summary: Implement basic SEO and accessibility fundamentals for the single Home page (semantic headings, alt text, meta title/description).
acceptanceCriteria: Headings follow a semantic hierarchy (one H1, logical H2/H3 structure).
All meaningful images include descriptive alt text (decorative images use empty alt where appropriate).
Home route has a meta title and description set.

file_operations.description: Set a Home-focused meta title and add a meta description appropriate for a modern creative digital agency landing page.
Ensure the page has exactly one H1 (in Hero) and that hero imagery includes correct alt text semantics (descriptive where meaningful; empty alt for decorative).
Apply semantic section structure and heading hierarchy (H2/H3) aligned with the single-page layout.
Ensure heading hierarchy and accessible interactive elements (focus-visible, labels as needed) for services cards/CTAs.
Ensure portfolio thumbnails have meaningful alt text and headings follow the page hierarchy.
Ensure avatar images and testimonial markup are accessible (alt text for avatars; semantic headings).

requirements.summary: Add and render locally generated static images from frontend/public/assets/generated in Hero and key sections (portfolio thumbnails, testimonial avatars, decorative accents).
acceptanceCriteria: All required generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by the Home page UI.
Hero section uses a generated hero visual.
Featured work/testimonials sections use generated thumbnails/avatars rather than external URLs.

file_operations.description: Add the required generated hero image asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-visual.dim_1600x900.png for use in the Hero section.
Add the required generated portfolio thumbnail asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/portfolio-01.dim_800x600.png for Featured Work cards.
Add the required generated portfolio thumbnail asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/portfolio-02.dim_800x600.png for Featured Work cards.
Add the required generated portfolio thumbnail asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/portfolio-03.dim_800x600.png for Featured Work cards.
Add the required generated testimonial avatar asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/avatar-01.dim_256x256.png for the Testimonials section.
Add the required generated testimonial avatar asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/avatar-02.dim_256x256.png for the Testimonials section.
Add the required generated testimonial avatar asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/avatar-03.dim_256x256.png for the Testimonials section.
Add the required decorative accent image at frontend/public/assets/generated/shape-accent-01.dim_512x512.png for use as subtle background/section accents.
Add the required decorative accent image at frontend/public/assets/generated/shape-accent-02.dim_512x512.png for use as subtle background/section accents.

Reference the exact generated asset paths (frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-visual.dim_1600x900.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/portfolio-01.dim_800x600.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/portfolio-02.dim_800x600.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/portfolio-03.dim_800x600.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/avatar-01.dim_256x256.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/avatar-02.dim_256x256.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/avatar-03.dim_256x256.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/shape-accent-01.dim_512x512.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/shape-accent-02.dim_512x512.png) so sections consume them from one place.

Render the hero visual using frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-visual.dim_1600x900.png and optionally incorporate shape accents (frontend/public/assets/generated/shape-accent-01.dim_512x512.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/shape-accent-02.dim_512x512.png) as decorative elements with appropriate alt handling.
Render featured work thumbnails using the locally generated portfolio images (frontend/public/assets/generated/portfolio-01.dim_800x600.png, portfolio-02, portfolio-03) rather than external URLs.
Render testimonial avatars using the locally generated avatar images (frontend/public/assets/generated/avatar-01.dim_256x256.png, avatar-02, avatar-03) rather than external URLs.
